items.title: House Lawmakers Introduce Bill Requiring Reports on AI-Built Models
items.rationale: AI policy, new bill: the bipartisan Recursive Self-Improvement Safety Act (Gottheimer and Moran, Nov 24) would require frontier developers above a compute threshold and $100M+ in training spend to file quarterly reports with a new Commerce office on AI involvement in their own R&D. Civil penalties go up to $10M.
items.excerpt: Reps. Josh Gottheimer and Nathaniel Moran introduced the bipartisan Recursive Self-Improvement Safety Act on Nov 24. Developers above a compute threshold who spent $100M+ on training would file quarterly reports on AI involvement and human oversight in R&D with a new Commerce office, with civil penalties up to $10M. Off-list; primary not located.

items.title: UK government rejects national consultation on AI datacenters
items.rationale: AI infrastructure policy, official response: after a petition passed 39,000 signatures, the UK government refused a UK-wide consultation on the environmental impact of AI datacenters. It said environmental checks will stay project by project, which affects how AI compute gets sited in Britain.
items.excerpt: The UK government rejected calls for a UK-wide public consultation on the environmental impact of AI datacenters, even though a petition passed 39,000 signatures. Ministers pointed to environmental checks done project by project instead.

items.title: Parliamentary inquiry pushes for ban on election AI deepfakes
items.rationale: AI in elections, official report: a bipartisan Australian parliamentary inquiry recommended examining electoral-law changes that would outlaw deepfakes in election material and political ads. This is a concrete step toward a national ban on synthetic campaign media.
items.excerpt: A bipartisan Australian parliamentary inquiry called for a committee to examine changes to electoral law that would outlaw deepfakes in election material and political ads. Off-list outlet.

items.title: '경남지사 선거 딥페이크 의혹' 12명 송치…박완수 지사 불송치
items.rationale: AI in elections, enforcement: police closed the probe into deepfake videos and alleged official interference in the Gyeongnam governor race from the June 3 local elections. They referred 12 campaign staff and officials to prosecutors and did not refer Governor Park Wan-su.
items.excerpt: 경찰이 6·3 지방선거 당시 경남지사 후보 캠프에서 불거진 딥페이크 영상·관권선거 의혹 수사를 마치고 캠프 관계자와 공무원 등 12명을 송치했고, 박완수 지사는 불송치했다. 외부 매체(off-list).

items.title: 러시아 소버린 AI 지원 계획...자국 모델 지원 4대 요건 제시
items.rationale: AI geopolitics, executive order: Putin ordered an update to Russia's national AI strategy to 2036 and approval of an action plan. He set four requirements for state support of domestic models and floated a mandatory AI-model and agent choice screen on domestic mobile operating systems.
items.excerpt: 푸틴 러시아 대통령이 26일 '2036년까지의 러시아 AI 국가전략' 갱신과 국가 행동계획 승인을 지시하고, 자국 AI 모델 지원 요건 4가지를 제시했다. 국내 모바일 운영체제에 AI 모델·에이전트 선택 화면을 의무화하는 방안도 포함됐다. 외부 매체(off-list).
